contact.basis: Bare-earth interpolation from open plaza and street samples in the provider DTM.

sources.attribution: OpenGeoHub Global Ensemble Digital Terrain Model (GEDTM30), CC BY 4.0
sources.method: Open GEDTM30 crop with unchanged native samples and 0.1 scale. Terrain review field interpolates the documented open plaza and street samples using inverse squared distance. It omits residual rooftop heights and canal cells from interpolation.
